:::{#def-cv-se}
#### Standard error of a cross-validation estimate

In [$k$-fold cross-validation](#def-kfold),
let $\foldmse{j}$ be the [mean squared error](estimation.qmd#def-prediction-mse)
of the predictions for the $\foldsize{j}$ observations in [fold](#def-folds) $\fold{j}$,
each from the rule $\fittedwo{j}{\cdot}$ of @def-cv-estimate:

$$
\foldmse{j} \eqdef \frac{1}{\foldsize{j}} \sum_{i \in \fold{j}} \sqf{\fittedwo{j}{x_i} - y_i}.
$$ {#eq-fold-mse}

Let $\cvsd$ be the
[sample standard deviation](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-sample-sd)
of $\foldmse{1}, \ldots, \foldmse{k}$.
The **standard error** of the cross-validation estimate is

$$
\cvse \eqdef \frac{\cvsd}{\sqrt{k}}.
$$ {#eq-cv-se}
